page.overview:
Who is Dekadin?

Dekadin is a sad, humorless boy who lives in his in Lynna Village in the past, where the Comedian is found in the present. Dekadin's house is very dark and gloomy, which suits the boy's mood. The cause of Dekadin's depression is implied to be due to be partially due to a recent book, he read.

Dekadin plays a role in the . Link can tell Dekadin the Funny Joke in an attempt to make Dekadin laugh. As thanks, Dekadin will let Link take a book from his bookshelf. This book happens to be the Touching Book, the next item in the .
